condo: OCHO - Freehold Development at 27 Lorong 32 Geylang

history.summary: Same Ocho freehold development (27 Lorong 32 Geylang, D14), a 4BR (1205 sqft) at $2.2M / $1826 PSF, completing 2028, ~810m to Dakota MRT (CC8). Freehold near the Circle Line is appealing, but this is a small Geylang boutique with no resale data to verify pricing or exit liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold, ~810m to Dakota MRT (CC8), Paya Lebar Central nearby, and a nearer 2028 completion than the sister listing. But there is no URA appreciation, txn count, or median PSF to verify the $1826 PSF, and small Geylang-fringe freehold blocks are illiquid and stigma-prone. A reasonable freehold play but unverifiable as an investment, so Neutral.
red_flags: No URA appreciation, txn count, or median PSF — pricing unverifiable
Small boutique Geylang development — limited liquidity, location stigma
Under-construction (2028 TOP) — no near-term rental and build-quality unknown
catalysts: Freehold tenure ~810m to Dakota MRT (Circle Line)
Paya Lebar Central transformation lifting the D14 corridor
